function normalize(value) {
  return String(value || "")
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize("NFKC")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();
}

function extractDomainFromEmail(email) {
  const match = normalize(email).match(/@([a-z0-9.-]+)/);
  return match ? match[1] : "";
}

function extractEmail(value) {
  const raw = String(value || "");
  return (
    raw.match(/<([^>]+)>/)?.[1] ||
    raw.match(/[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}/i)?.[0] ||
    ""
  ).toLowerCase();
}

function domainMatches(senderDomain, ruleDomain) {
  const sender = normalize(senderDomain);
  const rule = normalize(ruleDomain);

  if (!sender || !rule) return false;

  return sender === rule || sender.endsWith("." + rule);
}

function keywordHits(haystack, keywords) {
  const hits = [];

  for (const keyword of keywords || []) {
    const k = normalize(keyword);
    if (k && haystack.includes(k)) {
      hits.push(keyword);
    }
  }

  return [...new Set(hits)];
}

function scoreRule(rule, senderDomain, fromEmail, haystack) {
  let score = 0;

  const matchedDomains = [];
  const matchedKeywords = [];

  for (const domain of rule.domains || []) {
    if (domainMatches(senderDomain, domain)) {
      matchedDomains.push(domain);
      score += 70;
    }
  }

  const hits = keywordHits(haystack, rule.keywords || []);
  matchedKeywords.push(...hits);
  score += hits.length * 20;

  // Bonus, wenn Domain UND Keywords passen
  if (matchedDomains.length > 0 && matchedKeywords.length > 0) {
    score += 20;
  }

  // Sehr konkrete Trusted-Regeln dürfen bei starken Keyword-Treffern höher bewertet werden
  if (rule.trusted && matchedKeywords.length >= 2 && score < 70) {
    score = 70;
  }

  score = Math.min(score, 100);

  return {
    label: rule.label,
    group: rule.group,
    score,
    trusted: !!rule.trusted,
    matchedDomains,
    matchedKeywords,
    minScore: rule.minScore || 70
  };
}

function confidenceFromScore(score, trusted) {
  if (trusted && score >= 70) return 0.94;
  if (score >= 95) return 0.99;
  if (score >= 90) return 0.97;
  if (score >= 80) return 0.92;
  if (score >= 70) return 0.86;
  if (score >= 40) return 0.65;
  return 0.3;
}

return items.map(item => {
  const fromRaw = item.json.from_raw || item.json.From || item.json.from || "";
  const fromEmail = item.json.from_email || extractEmail(fromRaw);
  const fromName = item.json.from_name || "";
  const senderDomain =
    item.json.sender_domain ||
    extractDomainFromEmail(fromEmail) ||
    extractDomainFromEmail(fromRaw);

  const subject = item.json.subject || item.json.Subject || "";
  const snippet = item.json.snippet || "";
  const attachments = Array.isArray(item.json.attachments) ? item.json.attachments : [];

  const haystack = normalize([
    fromRaw,
    fromEmail,
    fromName,
    senderDomain,
    subject,
    snippet,
    attachments.join(" "),
    item.json.classification_text || ""
  ].join(" "));

  const labels = new Set();
  const workflowLabels = new Set();

  const allRuleResults = RULES
    .map(rule => scoreRule(rule, senderDomain, fromEmail, haystack))
    .filter(result => result.score >= result.minScore)
    .sort((a, b) => {
      if (b.score !== a.score) return b.score - a.score;
      if (b.trusted !== a.trusted) return Number(b.trusted) - Number(a.trusted);
      return 0;
    });

  /**
   * Pro Gruppe nur der beste Treffer.
   * Beispiel:
   * - Amazon KDP schlägt normales Amazon
   * - Haspa / ING / Santander nicht gleichzeitig
   * - YouTube / TikTok / Instagram nicht gleichzeitig
   */
  const bestByGroup = new Map();

  for (const result of allRuleResults) {
    if (!bestByGroup.has(result.group)) {
      bestByGroup.set(result.group, result);
    }
  }

  const selectedRuleResults = Array.from(bestByGroup.values())
    .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);

  for (const result of selectedRuleResults) {
    labels.add(result.label);
  }

  // Workflow: Dringend
  const urgentHits = keywordHits(haystack, URGENT_KEYWORDS);
  if (urgentHits.length > 0) {
    workflowLabels.add("AUTO/Dringend");
  }

  // Workflow: Fehler
  const errorHits = keywordHits(haystack, ERROR_KEYWORDS);
  if (errorHits.length > 0) {
    workflowLabels.add("AUTO/Fehler");
  }

  // Workflow: Spam
  const spamHits = keywordHits(haystack, SPAM_KEYWORDS);
  if (spamHits.length > 0) {
    workflowLabels.add("AUTO/SPAM");
  }

  // Workflow: Wichtig
  const importantHits = [];

  for (const rule of IMPORTANT_RULES) {
    const domainHit = (rule.domains || []).some(domain => domainMatches(senderDomain, domain));
    const hits = keywordHits(haystack, rule.keywords || []);

    if (domainHit || hits.length > 0) {
      importantHits.push({
        domains: rule.domains,
        matched_keywords: hits
      });
    }
  }

  if (importantHits.length > 0) {
    workflowLabels.add("AUTO/Wichtig");
    workflowLabels.add("AUTO/Dringend");
  }

  for (const workflowLabel of workflowLabels) {
    labels.add(workflowLabel);
  }

  const bestScore = selectedRuleResults.length > 0
    ? selectedRuleResults[0].score
    : 0;

  const trustedCategoryFound = selectedRuleResults.some(result => result.trusted);

  let confidence = confidenceFromScore(bestScore, trustedCategoryFound);

  if (labels.size === 0) {
    labels.add("AUTO/Review");
    confidence = 0.3;
  }

  const categoryLabels = Array.from(labels).filter(label => !WORKFLOW_LABELS.has(label));

  /**
   * KI nur, wenn:
   * - keine Kategorie erkannt wurde
   * - oder Confidence niedrig ist
   * - außer: Trusted-Regel hat bereits sauber getroffen
   */
  const needsAi = categoryLabels.length === 0 || (!trustedCategoryFound && confidence < 0.85);

  if (needsAi) {
    labels.add("AUTO/Review");
  }

  const finalLabels = Array.from(labels);

  item.json.classification = {
    labels: finalLabels,
    category_labels: categoryLabels,
    workflow_labels: Array.from(workflowLabels),
    primary_label: categoryLabels[0] || "AUTO/Review",
    confidence,
    needs_ai: needsAi,
    source: needsAi ? "rules_low_confidence" : "rules",
    matched_rules: selectedRuleResults,
    urgent_hits: urgentHits,
    error_hits: errorHits,
    spam_hits: spamHits,
    important_hits: importantHits
  };

  item.json.label_names = finalLabels;
  item.json.primary_label = categoryLabels[0] || "AUTO/Review";
  item.json.needs_ai = needsAi;
  item.json.classification_confidence = confidence;
  item.json.classification_source = needsAi ? "rules_low_confidence" : "rules";

  return item;
});

- Wenn keine Kategorie sicher passt: AUTO/Review.
- Bei Spam/Verdacht auf Spam: AUTO/SPAM.
- Bei technischen Fehlern: AUTO/Fehler.
- Bei dringenden, sicherheitskritischen oder fristkritischen Mails: AUTO/Dringend.
- Nutze keine Labels außerhalb der Liste.
- Antworte exakt in diesem JSON-Format:
{"labels":["AUTO/Review"],"confidence":0.3,"reason":"kurze technische Begründung"}

function extractLabels(json) {
  const raw = [];

  if (Array.isArray(json.labels)) {
    for (const label of json.labels) {
      if (typeof label === "string") {
        raw.push(label);
      } else if (label?.id) {
        raw.push(label.id);
      } else if (label?.name) {
        raw.push(label.name);
      }
    }
  }

  if (Array.isArray(json.labelIds)) {
    raw.push(...json.labelIds);
  }

  if (Array.isArray(json.gmail_labels)) {
    raw.push(...json.gmail_labels);
  }

  return [...new Set(raw.filter(Boolean))];
}

return items.map(item => {
  const labels = extractLabels(item.json);

  const hasAutoLabel = labels.some(label =>
    AUTO_LABEL_IDS.has(label) ||
    AUTO_LABEL_NAMES.has(label) ||
    String(label).startsWith("AUTO/")
  );

  const isTrash = labels.includes("TRASH");
  const isSpam = labels.includes("SPAM");
  const isDraft = labels.includes("DRAFT");
  const isSent = labels.includes("SENT");

  /**
   * Verarbeitungslogik:
   * - bereits AUTO-gelabelt: überspringen
   * - Trash/Spam/Draft/Sent: überspringen
   * - alles andere: verarbeiten
   */
  const skipReasons = [];

  if (hasAutoLabel) skipReasons.push("already_auto_labeled");
  if (isTrash) skipReasons.push("trash");
  if (isSpam) skipReasons.push("gmail_spam");
  if (isDraft) skipReasons.push("draft");
  if (isSent) skipReasons.push("sent");

  const shouldProcess = skipReasons.length === 0;

  item.json.preflight = {
    should_process: shouldProcess,
    skip_reasons: skipReasons,
    existing_labels: labels,
    has_auto_label: hasAutoLabel
  };

  item.json.should_process = shouldProcess;
  item.json.skip_reasons = skipReasons;

  return item;
});
